# GeminiWatermarkAI

> Free, 100% client-side AI image watermark cleaner powered by mathematical reverse alpha blending.

## Overview
GeminiWatermarkAI is a high-speed, privacy-first web utility designed to remove visible watermark logos and sparkle badges from images generated by Google Gemini, Google Imagen 3, and Google Flow. The entire processing pipeline executes entirely inside the user's browser via HTML5 Canvas 2D image manipulation. No user images or data are ever uploaded to external servers.

## Key Features
- **100% Free Forever**: No sign-up, no email registration, and zero subscription paywalls.
- **Client-Side Privacy**: All processing runs in the browser. Zero server transmission.
- **Mathematical Lossless Quality**: Uses exact Reverse Alpha Blending rather than generative inpainting AI hallucinations.
- **Batch Processing**: Clean multiple AI images in seconds with one-click zip download.
- **Multi-Language Support**: Fully localized in English, Chinese (中文), Japanese (日本語), Spanish (Español), German (Deutsch), French (Français), Portuguese (Português), and Korean (한국어).

- [Reverse Alpha Blending vs AI Inpainting](https://geminiwatermarkai.online/blog/reverse-alpha-blending-vs-inpainting): Why mathematical inversion preserves original pixels without AI blurring.
- [Google Imagen 3 & Gemini Watermark Guide](https://geminiwatermarkai.online/blog/how-to-remove-gemini-watermark-free): Step-by-step tutorial on cleaning AI illustrations.
- [SynthID vs Visible Watermarks](https://geminiwatermarkai.online/blog/google-synthid-vs-visible-watermarks): Understanding the difference between visible overlays and invisible cryptographic watermarks.
- [Canvas Engineering in Web Browsers](https://geminiwatermarkai.online/blog/in-browser-canvas-watermark-removal): How client-side Canvas 2D manipulation ensures 100% user privacy.
